title: A 4GS/s Fully Analog 256×256 MP-Based Cross-Correlator with 1000TOPS/W Compute Efficiency and 1.3TOPS/mm2 Compute Density in 22nm SOI CMOS
problem: Multi-lag cross-correlation (X-Corr) is essential for radar range/velocity detection and communication synchronization; traditional digital approaches (ADC + MACs) achieve only 5–20 TOPS/W; analog approaches require on-chip delays and multiple correlators causing large area/power overhead.
motivation: Power-constrained applications (radar, comm sensors) demand high-efficiency X-Corr engines that are compact (single-lag analog correlators scale poorly to N lags). Analog compute offers order-of-magnitude efficiency gains vs. digital at cost of accuracy and integration complexity.
method: Fully-analog 256×256 cross-correlator using margin-propagation (MP) based four-transistor analog compute cells. Sampling-based approach creates large analog delays on-chip without dedicated delay-line area. Single-shot readout across all 256 X-Corr lags via MP propagation.
key_novelty: Margin-propagation (MP) analog compute cell achieving 256-length X-Corr with high efficiency (996–1060 TOPS/W) and compute density (1.3 TOPS/mm^2).
contributions: Single-shot 256-lag readout (vs. N sequential readouts with traditional approaches)
8.2–8.5 bit compute accuracy (51–53dB hardware dynamic range)
1000+ TOPS/W efficiency (6.6x better than prior analog correlators)
1.3 TOPS/mm^2 compute density (7x better than prior work)
Demonstrated X-band radar with 15cm range resolution, 256 range bins, 1024 chirp averages, 115Hz refresh

metrics.speedup: 6.6x vs. prior analog, orders-of-magnitude vs. digital ADC+MAC

baselines: Prior single-lag analog correlators (low area efficiency when replicated)
limitations: Analog compute inherently sensitive to mismatch and temperature variation; PVT compensation not detailed in abstract. Radar demo uses synthetic targets; real-world clutter/noise performance not discussed.
primary_theme: Ultra-efficient fully-analog multi-lag cross-correlator for radar/communications
